profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple | Previously @Meta, @Zynga
profile.summary:
Tech Skills in: 
• Objective-C, Swift, TypeScript, C++, C, C#, Java.
• Node.js, Ruby on Rails, ASP.NET, PHP, Javascript, jQuery, AJAX, HTML, XML, and CSS.

Mobile:
• iOS development, ReactNative. Familiar with Android development.

Databases
• MongosDB, SQL, CoreData, Realm

Specialties:
• Ojective-C, Swift, C, C#, ASP.Net, jQuery, HTML + CSS.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer/iOS Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led small teams from 3 to 5 engineers building iOS native applications as well as web APIs.
• Implemented key features of iOS applications as well as the base architecture of the projects.
• Developed and maintained iOS Framework used across the company to facilitate and reduce the work load of iOS projects.
• Participated  and played a key role in the full life cycle of iOS mobile applications of different categories like Social Network, Music, Sport, Finance, and Games.
• Developed custom controls and user interface elements. 
• Dealt with the process of submitting apps to the App Store.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Created and maintained Websites for the Undergraduate Education Department of Florida International University. 
•	Developed and customized SharePoint websites.
•	Developed Web Applications (ASP.NET/C#/MySQL). 
•	Participated in the development and maintenance of a database application to track students’ visits to the Academic Advising Center (VB / Microsoft Access).  
•	Offered PC technical support to Department of Undergraduate Education. 
•	Used software and technologies such as C#, ASP.Net, Ajax, jQuery, Javascript, PHP, HTML, CSS, MySQL, SharePoint,  MS Office, Visual Studio,  and  Adobe Creative Suite.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed software to track inventory(C#.NET/SQL Server).
•	Developed Websites and Web Applications (C#.NET/SQL Server).
•	Developed and integrated algorithms to determine textual implications (C++). 
•	Related algorithms to systems of artificial intelligence (C#.NET, C++).
•	Tested algorithms’ efficiency.
